body: Is this your area @cescoffier or perhaps @ozangunalp ?

We were discussing about suppressing some of those standard logs. 
As a start you can change the level of those loggers 
```
quarkus.log.category."org.apache.kafka.clients".level=WARN
quarkus.log.category."org.apache.kafka.common.utils".level=WARN
quarkus.log.category."org.apache.kafka.common.metrics".level=WARN
```
What is the best way of doing this inside the Quarkus extension? Registering a default config for the log level as such or adding a `LogCleanupFilter`?

If we disagree that their logs should be at INFO, and they have real INFO logs that we should allow because they're important, then yeah we can use `LogCleanupFilter`, that's for individual logs where we disagree about their levels.

Let's take them one by one:

```
INFO  [io.sma.rea.mes.kafka] (Quarkus Main Thread) SRMSG18248: Key serializer omitted, using String as default <-- should be debug, that's on our side
INFO  [io.sma.rea.mes.kafka] (Quarkus Main Thread) SRMSG18237: Setting client.id for Kafka producer to kafka-producer-warehouse <-- should be debug, that's on our side

# The big block here is often useful, but we can configure it to "debug"
INFO  [org.apa.kaf.cli.pro.ProducerConfig] (Quarkus Main Thread) ProducerConfig values: 
	acks = 1
	batch.size = 16384
	bootstrap.servers = [PLAINTEXT://localhost:49257]
...

INFO  [org.apa.kaf.com.uti.AppInfoParser] (Quarkus Main Thread) Kafka version: 2.8.0 <-- should be hidden
INFO  [org.apa.kaf.com.uti.AppInfoParser] (Quarkus Main Thread) Kafka commitId: ebb1d6e21cc92130 <-- should be hidden
INFO  [org.apa.kaf.com.uti.AppInfoParser] (Quarkus Main Thread) Kafka startTimeMs: 1631711047014 <-- hidden too
…
INFO  [org.apa.kaf.com.met.Metrics] (smallrye-kafka-producer-thread-1) Metrics scheduler closed <-- should be hidden
INFO  [org.apa.kaf.com.met.Metrics] (smallrye-kafka-producer-thread-1) Closing reporter org.apache.kafka.common.metrics.JmxReporter <-- yet again JMX, should be buried 
INFO  [org.apa.kaf.com.met.Metrics] (smallrye-kafka-producer-thread-1) Metrics reporters closed <-- should be hidden
```

I'm not sure we want to set the level to WARN, they may be some additional interesting messages. 
However, some of them are useless to regular users, and I'm +1 to hide them.  We can start with setting the log level to WARN and see if we get feedback. 

The two first messages are on our side, so we can just change the level.
